comment_regular: Ambient DialogueItem constructor. Unlike player MenuTopic::FillResponseList, this path appends every collected TESResponse without filtering empty display text and without INFOGENERAL/D7's first-nonempty-response limit. An ambient RUMOR item can therefore retain all authored responses.
